title: Total small etale site of a simplicial scheme
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of finite nonempty ordered sets $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n\}$ and order-preserving maps. A simplicial scheme is a contravariant functor $U_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sch}$ [def-pc-scheme]; write $u_\alpha:U_n\to U_m$ for the map attached to $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$. Use the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and the common containing universe and small skeletons of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define the category $\mathcal C(U_\bullet)$ as follows: its objects are pairs $(n,W\to U_n)$ with $W\to U_n$ etale; an arrow $(n,W)\to(m,Z)$ is a pair $(\alpha,f)$ with $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$ and a $U_n$-map $f:W\to U_n\times_{U_m}Z$. The identity uses the identity order map and identity scheme map. Composition uses composition of the order maps and the canonical base-change identifications. Equip it with the topology generated by the families $\{(n,W_i)\to(n,W)\}_i$ with identity order map and $\{W_i\to W\}_i$ an etale covering [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. The total etale topos is $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C(U_\bullet))$. For a commutative ring $\Lambda$, put $\Lambda_{\mathrm{tot}}$ equal to the sheafification of the constant ring presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and write $\operatorname{Mod}(U_\bullet,\Lambda)=\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{tot}})$ for its module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Restriction $e_n$ means evaluation on all objects $(n,W)$. An augmentation to a scheme $X$ is a family $a_n:U_n\to X$ with $a_m u_\alpha=a_n$ for every $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$.
